title: Be told which file failed and what state it is in

action.name: alpha.jpg. Couldn’t verify cleaned output. The incomplete copy was removed; your original is unchanged.
test.jpg. Couldn’t verify cleaned output. The incomplete copy was removed; your original is unchanged.

steps.note: The failed row opens to its error detail; no e2e expands a failed row.

action.gesture: click the error text to copy it

steps.note: The error text is a pre with a click handler and no role or tab stop, so a keyboard user cannot copy it; register entry dead-end|file-list-errorexpansion--verification|click-to-copy-not-keyboard-reachable.

No retry control exists for a failed file: the error row offers only expand and the only Try again resets a render crash on another screen; register entry dead-end|screens-app--all-error|no-retry-for-failed-file.
